lua_assertions:
local function po(level, name, ...)
    return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_' .. level, name, ...)
end
local function current(time, x, maximum)
    _ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(time, 100)
    assert(po('Current', 'TimeSpacing') == 0)
    assert(math.abs(po('Current', 'XMod') - x) < 0.000001,
        'Current ScrollSpeed at ' .. time .. ': ' .. po('Current', 'XMod'))
    assert(po('Current', 'MaxScrollBPM') == maximum,
        'Current MaxScrollBPM at ' .. time .. ': ' .. po('Current', 'MaxScrollBPM'))
    if maximum == 0 then
        assert(po('Current', 'MMod') == nil)
    else
        assert(po('Current', 'MMod') == maximum)
    end
end

-- Dyscontrolled Galaxy starts with a profile M-mod, clears Song options and
-- then applies X-mod strings. Native fields approach independently:
-- FromOneModString updates ScrollSpeed/TimeSpacing approaches but only
-- clears MaxScrollBPM's target, leaving its default one-BPM-per-second rate.
po('Stage', 'SetPlayerOptions', 'm690')
po('Song', 'FromString', 'clearall')
po('Song', 'FromString', '*2 2x')
assert(po('Stage', 'MMod') == 690 and po('Current', 'MMod') == 690)
local value, speed = po('Song', 'XMod')
assert(value == 2 and speed == 2)
value, speed = po('Song', 'MaxScrollBPM')
assert(value == 0 and speed == 1)
current(0, 1, 690)
current(0.125, 1.25, 689.875)
current(0.5, 2, 689.5)
current(10, 2, 680)
current(689.875, 2, 0.125)
current(690, 2, 0)
-- XMod's getter also returns while MMod is active. ArrowEffects selects the
-- nonzero MaxScrollBPM until it reaches zero, rather than selecting the
-- most recently written Song speed-mode alias.

-- The direct Lua XMod(value, approach) API changes every speed approach.
po('Stage', 'SetPlayerOptions', 'm690')
po('Song', 'FromString', 'clearall')
po('Song', 'FromString', '*2 2x')
current(690.5, 2, 689.5)
po('Song', 'XMod', 1.3, 10000)
for _, name in ipairs({'TimeSpacing', 'ScrollSpeed', 'ScrollBPM', 'MaxScrollBPM'}) do
    local _, approach = po('Song', name)
    assert(approach == 10000, 'direct XMod sets all speed approach rates')
end
current(690.5625, 1.3, 64.5)
current(690.625, 1.3, 0)

-- Preserve ordinary continuous X-mod approaches, including a frozen target.
po('Stage', 'SetPlayerOptions', '1x')
po('Song', 'XMod', 3, 2)
current(690.75, 1.25, 0)
current(691, 1.75, 0)
current(691.625, 3, 0)
po('Song', 'XMod', 1, 0)
current(700, 3, 0)
po('Song', 'XMod', 1, 2)
current(700.5, 2, 0)
current(701, 1, 0)
